Bill.BriefDescription: Setting employee salaries upon reallocation or layoff action.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to setting employee salaries upon reallocation orlayoff action; and adding a new section to chapter 41.06 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.06 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: An employee who is occupying a position that is reallocated to aclass with a lower salary range, or is appointed to a position due toa layoff action, shall have his or her base salary determined accordingto the employer's salary determination policy for the class and rangeof the employee's new position without regard to the employee's basesalary in his or her previous position.
